interface.longDescription: Clean scratches, dust and fading in an attached photograph, optionally colorize it, or enlarge it by 2× or 4× with face reconstruction disabled. Compare the original and result in an inline widget with Open, Download and fullscreen. Restoration can alter fine details and colorization is inferred. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Clean up this faded photo while preserving the people.
